checks.lead: Zhao Mo (175-124 BC, Chinese: 趙眜; pinyin: Zhào Mò) also known as Emperor Wen and as Triệu Mạt or Triệu Văn Đế in Vietnamese was the second ruler of Nanyue. He succeeded his grandfather Zhao Tuo (Emperor Wu) in 137 BC and reigned until his death in 124 BC.
